name: Title IX Coordinator Contact Notice for Pregnant Students
description: When informed of a student's pregnancy, an employee provides the Title IX Coordinator's contact information and documents the notification.
quote: When a student, parent/guardian of a student, or other individual with a legal right to act on behalf of a student informs a District employee of the student’s pregnancy or related conditions, the employee shall promptly notify that individual of the Title IX Coordinator’s contact information
